title: Meridian Foghorn, Jacaranda Jetway, Offline Woods
summary: On a misty meridian, a ghastly foghorn lies, overlooked by playful amphibians in facemasks. Monkeys mosh nearby, celebrating a novum. A lone kitty, winded but empowered, senses something amiss. A teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, navigates a jacaranda jetway, her multichannel delivery deemed overkill and a felony. Eyewitnesses report vertigo as her outlaw ship docks, but a clucky chameleon offers friendship. Later, deep in the woods, she is offline, sanity afflicted by occultism and negative logbook entries. A cricket nibbled her systems, its jokes disjunctive. The governor's lowdown plan becomes clear. Yet, an alien among gruffy saints, she unblocks her micro-trajectory. She outjumps champions, embracing subjective art, transforming terra into icebergs. Her offhand triumph, a whistler's song in the quiet evening, creating a new world.
